summary: Tested the plan recommendation in the 'Attiva abbonamento' dialog (MySubscription PlanPickerDialog) and the new over-limits check in backend /saas/checkout. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. A fresh org gets 400 billing_missing first. Once billing data is filled in, Bronze checkout with 0 usage returns a Stripe test checkout_url (no payment completed). With 2 events, Bronze returns 400 'Il piano BRONZE non copre il tuo utilizzo attuale: hai 2 eventi (max 1). Scegli un piano superiore.' for both cycles, while Silver is still allowed. Frontend on the fresh trial org test_plan_1795036699: the title is 'Attiva abbonamento'. The default cycle is 12 mesi, which shows the SILVER message and a teal #0ABAB5 badge and card border. 6 mesi shows the GOLD message and a gold #D4AF37 badge and card border. data-recommended and the plan-recommended-* badges are exclusive and correct. Toggling 4+ times updates instantly. Prices and billed totals match /api/saas/plans-public for both cycles (sem 19/49/79, totals 114/294/474; yearly 15,20/39,20/63,20, totals 182,40/470,40/758,40). All three buttons are enabled at 0 usage. Clicking Bronze while GOLD is recommended sent POST /saas/checkout {plan:'bronze', cycle:'semester'} and returned the expected billing_missing toast. Org with 2 events: plan-over-limits-bronze reads 'Non disponibile: hai 2 eventi (max 1).', sub-choose-bronze is disabled, and Silver and Gold are enabled. Responsive at 768 and 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals the viewport) and all buttons can be reached by scrolling inside the dialog. Super Admin assistance mode (POST /platform/impersonate on the test org): same dialog, same recommendation logic and same over-limits state.

minor.issue: The backend applies per-org Super Admin limit overrides (org.saas.admin max_events/max_users) in the over-limits check, but the frontend fitsUsage/overText uses only the catalog limits (p.max_events/p.max_users). For an org with custom limits, a card can look choosable and then fail with 400, or look disabled when the backend would accept it. Suggest exposing the effective per-plan limits in /saas/me, or reusing s.limits.

ui_bugs.component: CookieBanner over PlanPickerDialog (pre-existing, not part of this feature)
ui_bugs.issue: When the dialog opens via ?upgrade=1 before cookie consent, the cookie banner (z-10000) is drawn over the dialog, but Radix sets body pointer-events:none, so 'Accept all', 'Reject non-essential' and 'Customise' cannot be clicked (computed pointer-events: none). On mobile 390 the banner hides the lower half of the dialog. The user has to close the dialog to dismiss it. Fix: add pointer-events:auto on the banner, or render it outside the Radix modal scope. The banner also defaults to EN in an Italian app.

ui_bugs.component: Demo popup ('Scopri CRMEvent con una demo gratuita', pre-existing)
ui_bugs.issue: On an org with events, a demo-request modal opens automatically on top of the open plan picker dialog and blocks it until 'Non ora' is clicked. Stacking modals on a purchase flow is poor UX: suppress the demo popup while the plan picker or upgrade=1 is open.

issues: The SILVER plan label colour #A3A3A3 on a white or light-teal card has low contrast (pre-existing catalog colour).

When the recommended plan is incompatible with usage (e.g. yearly with more than 5 events, so SILVER is excluded), there is no recommendation at all and only an empty

. You may want to fall back to GOLD.

action_items: (Optional) Align the frontend fitsUsage with the backend effective limits, including the Super Admin overrides in org.saas.admin.
(Pre-existing) Make the cookie banner clickable while a Radix dialog is open (pointer-events:auto), and suppress the auto demo popup while the plan picker is open.
critical_code_review_comments: MySubscription.jsx: recP requires the recommended plan to be shown, not current, and fitting usage. This is correct and never auto-selects anything. No recommendation is shown if the plan does not fit.
The backend over-limits message uses body.plan.upper() and not the plan label. This is fine for bronze/silver/gold.
The checkout over-limits check runs after billing_missing and after _live_sub. The order matches the request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the feature (2 pre-existing modal-overlap UX issues)
